description_target.target_text: Take the two framed binary templates and align them on a common canvas. Then read the code row: 4 → union, 5 → intersection, 6 → left-minus-right, 7 → xor. For each code, compute the corresponding boolean combination, color the kept cells with that code color, crop tightly, and place the result in a strip.

racket_target.raw_code:
(rule!
 ;; TWO maroon(9) rectangular frames hold shapes A (left) and B (right),
 ;; taken shape-only: binarized, cropped, and centered on a common canvas.
 ;; The BOTTOM row lists op codes: 4 = A OR B, 5 = A AND B, 6 = A MINUS B,
 ;; 7 = A XOR B. Each code paints its combination in its own color; the
 ;; results line up horizontally (vertically centered, 1-col gaps).
 (lambda (g)
   (let ()
     (define (crop-nonzero grid)
       (let ((cells (filter (lambda (p) (!= (at grid (first p) (second p)) 0))
                            (grid-positions grid))))
         (if (empty? cells)
             (list (list 0))
             (let ((bb (bbox-of-cells cells)))
               (subgrid grid (first bb) (second bb) (third bb) (fourth bb))))))
     (define (rect-frame? obj)
       ;; exactly the border of a >=3x3 bbox: every cell on the border AND
       ;; the cell count equals the perimeter
       (let* ((bb (obj-bbox obj))
              (hh (+ 1 (- (third bb) (first bb))))
              (ww (+ 1 (- (fourth bb) (second bb)))))
         (and (>= hh 3) (>= ww 3)
              (= (obj-size obj) (- (* 2 (+ hh ww)) 4))
              (all? (lambda (p) (or (= (first p) (first bb))
                                    (= (first p) (third bb))
                                    (= (second p) (second bb))
                                    (= (second p) (fourth bb))))
                    (obj-cells obj)))))
     (define frames
       (sort (filter (lambda (o) (and (= (obj-color o) 9) (rect-frame? o)))
                     (objects g 0))
             (lambda (a b) (< (second (obj-bbox a)) (second (obj-bbox b))))))
     (define (shape-in fr)
       ;; the frame interior as a cropped BINARY mask (1 = occupied)
       (let ((bb (obj-bbox fr)))
         (crop-nonzero
          (grid-from-fn (- (third bb) (first bb) 1)
                        (- (fourth bb) (second bb) 1)
                        (lambda (r c)
                          (if (= (at g (+ (first bb) 1 r) (+ (second bb) 1 c)) 0)
                              0 1))))))
     (define (pad-center grid hh ww)
       (paste (empty-grid hh ww 0) grid
              (quotient (- hh (rows grid)) 2)
              (quotient (- ww (cols grid)) 2)))
     (define (hstack-center pieces)
       (if (empty? pieces)
           (list (list))
           (let* ((hh (apply max (map rows pieces)))
                  (ww (+ (apply + (map cols pieces)) (- (length pieces) 1))))
             (let loop ((xs pieces) (left 0) (out (empty-grid hh ww 0)))
               (if (empty? xs)
                   out
                   (let ((piece (first xs)))
                     (loop (rest xs) (+ left (cols piece) 1)
                           (paste out piece
                                  (quotient (- hh (rows piece)) 2)
                                  left))))))))
     (let* ((a0 (shape-in (first frames)))
            (b0 (shape-in (second frames)))
            (hh (max (rows a0) (rows b0)))
            (ww (max (cols a0) (cols b0)))
            (a (pad-center a0 hh ww))
            (b (pad-center b0 hh ww))
            (codes (filter (lambda (v) (member? v (list 4 5 6 7))) (last g))))
       (hstack-center
        (for/list ((code (in-list codes)))
          (crop-nonzero
           (grid-from-fn hh ww
             (lambda (r c)
               (let ((aa (!= (at a r c) 0))
                     (bb (!= (at b r c) 0)))
                 (if (cond ((= code 4) (or aa bb))
                           ((= code 5) (and aa bb))
                           ((= code 6) (and aa (not bb)))
                           (else (not (equal? aa bb))))
                     code
                     0)))))))))))
